details.detail: Boarding THE Suite and THE Room window walls went lavender, which is new medium issue 1. L14's hue-preserving white tone (u_hueW) and lower-tub sky hue (u_tubHue) have no zone gate, so on the window side, which the cool shadow light (coolW) already tints, they keep a blue cast that per-channel ACES used to flatten. Window-wall pixels at L150-250, B-R median / cool share, L14 -> L15 (photo): q05 (0-300, 0-400) +5 / 45 % -> +16 / 72 % (f_17313 (0-330, 0-450) +1 / 22 %); q03 (0-260, 0-450) +5 / 43 % -> +15 / 85 % (f_17313 +1; omaat_f8 -11 / 0 %); q08 (450-930, 0-330) +6 / 47 % -> +20 / 75 % (c_27300 (0-930, 0-140) -5 / 5 %); q06 right wall (640-930, 150-340) +5 / 43 % -> +19 / 77 % (c_27312 (780-930, 100-330) +11 / 77 %). In-flight J / F daylight photos read neutral to warm (L170-250 in the top 300 rows): sc_room_06 / 07 / 08 / 09 / 10 / 11 / 13 -4..+2 (cool share 5-13 %), omaat_f2-f9 -12..-32. A runtime test with MOODS.boarding hueW x = 0 and tubHue 0 puts the walls back at +5 / 41 % (q03), +5 / 46 % (q05), +5 / 45 % (q08), with 0.00-0.10 % px moved in luminance, so the change is hue only. The same edit is right in the seat zones: whole-frame top-300-row cool share q06 25 -> 66 % (c_27312 60 %), q07 21 -> 54 % (c_27316 53 %), q10 18 -> 48 % (c_27315 60 %), so the fix gates the window side only.

Boarding economy window tubs went darker, which is new medium issue 2. L14's lensLo.x 0.95 -> 1.25 was meant to drop the lens wash on the pier, but it also took it off the recessed tub just above the pane. q17 (resected on y_47303), tub just above the pane (520-545 / 640-665, rows 50-70): L14 163 -> L15 148 / 145, vs the photo's (490-515 / 365-385) 161 / 163. Across the tub at row 60, the render dips from 165 / 154 at the edges to 139-141 in the centre, a visible grey blot; the photo is flat at 162-164. q15 tubs (65-95, 155-185 / 110-130, 150-190) 175 / 171 -> 166 / 163, where y_47300's reveals read near-white (L237-239). q16 near tubs (200-240, 190-230) 175 -> 163.
